title: Jett: The Plus-One
teaser: He was in every photo. He was never in the caption.

news.headline: Always the Accessory
news.body: Jett on life as the blur behind her selfies, and on Loretta's nickname for him: "the accessory." He swears he was building something. Then he admits he'd bought an engagement ring.
news.hook: He paid for it with Sarah's card.

news.headline: I Knew About Theo
news.body: Jett knew about the affair for three weeks and said nothing, because Theo had lent him $15K. Best friends, worse bookkeeping.
news.hook: His unsent Saturday-night text to Theo: "After tomorrow we settle everything."

news.headline: The $40K
news.body: Jett calls the transfers "loans" for a sneaker drop. Sarah found out the Thursday before she died and told him, "I'm not mad. I'm done."
news.hook: She let him keep the money. So why did he go to her garage on Sunday?

news.headline: Twenty Minutes in the Garage
news.body: He went to grab $40K of sneakers from his car before she could claim them, then sat in the garage for twenty minutes deciding whether to go up and propose anyway.
news.hook: His phone rings. It's Detective Okafor.

news.headline: The Speech I Didn't Give
news.body: His proposal speech, read aloud. He admits he loved the life more than he loved her. The proposal, it turns out, was Loretta's idea.
news.hook: He gives Loretta the ring to return. She doesn't.
